text: 中国铝业公告，预计2026年上半年实现归属于上市公司股东的净利润为人民币112亿元至人民币122亿元，同比增加58%至73%。预计归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润为人民币110亿元至人民币120亿元，同比增加58%至73%。
text_en: Aluminum Corporation of China announced that it expects net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company for the first half of 2026 to be between RMB 11.2 billion and RMB 12.2 billion, an increase of 58% to 73% year-on-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders excluding non-recurring gains and losses is expected to be between RMB 11.0 billion and RMB 12.0 billion, also up 58% to 73% year-on-year.
